description: Brandstationer is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.mcf.se. data on the location of fire stations; Rescue services are the municipality's responsibility under the Accident Prevention Act (2003:778). The municipality is responsible for supervision within the municipality's area and the county administrative board within the county. The central supervision is carried out by the MSB, which collects information about the fire stations. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Fire stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
